description: This PHP source file defines the BaseHandler class, which serves as a foundational utility class for handling common operations such as language loading, JavaScript inclusion, and redirection within the SuiteCRM application. It includes class properties, a constructor, and several protected methods for internal functionalities.

classes.name: BaseHandler
classes.description: A utility class providing common functionalities like language setup, JavaScript inclusion, and redirect handling for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BaseHandler with dependencies and sets up language and JavaScript configurations.

methods.name: getLanguage
methods.description: Assigns available languages to the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: getJavascipt
methods.description: Assigns JavaScript focus code to the Smarty template engine.

methods.name: protectedLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves the list of supported languages for the application.

methods.name: protectedJavascript
methods.description: Gets JavaScript code for setting focus behavior.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Performs an HTTP redirect to the specified URL, can be overridden for testing.

methods.name: protectedExit
methods.description: Exits execution, can be overridden for testing.

methods.name: protectedDie
methods.description: Terminates execution with a message, can be overridden for testing.
